description: The hydrogen hub making green ammonia for a contracted delivery of 50 → 100 → 150 t/d over 2027, 2030 and 2035, beside a 40 MW process load on a 200 MW connection. A fixed 160 t/d Haber-Bosch loop (minimum load, restart time), H2 and NH3 tanks to size, wind, solar, battery and electrolyser candidates per period; a shortfall is bought in as grey ammonia or paid as a contract penalty. Multi-period; ready for an Energy Hub study on a strong grid.

study_notes: Each period is the same representative week, with the period's NH3 delivery.
The Haber-Bosch loop is a fixed-size unit; the plan sizes the grid, storage, electrolysers and the two tanks.
Planning uses linearised unit commitment; the binary operational check after the solve reports what the relaxation understates (restarts and shortfall).
A stop costs the tonnes the NH3 tank cannot cover: they are bought in as grey ammonia or, beyond the contract's cover, paid at the shortfall penalty.
